I sat down with @LoganKilpatrickYT  from @googledeepmind and we vibe coded real apps live with AI Studio. We went from idea to working prototypes in minutes, including a video analysis app that extracts takeaways from uploads and a voice lead-gen agent that greets visitors and fills a form for me behind the scenes. We talked about why vibe coding lowers the barrier to building, how to package simple tools for specific users, and where the biggest opportunities are with Gemini, VO3, voice agents, and computer-use agents. This isn’t sponsored, and Google didn’t pay me, but I am a Google shareholder. If you’re looking for practical ways to start building with Google’s AI today, this one’s for you.
